tests.name: Basic Permission Groups Discovery Windows (Domain)
tests.description:
Basic Permission Groups Discovery for Windows. This test will display some errors if run on a computer not connected to a domain. Upon execution, domain
information will be displayed.

tests.name: Permission Groups Discovery PowerShell (Domain)
tests.description:
Permission Groups Discovery utilizing PowerShell. This test will display some errors if run on a computer not connected to a domain. Upon execution, domain
information will be displayed.

tests.name: Elevated group enumeration using net group (Domain)
tests.description:
Runs "net group" command including command aliases and loose typing to simulate enumeration/discovery of high value domain groups. This
test will display some errors if run on a computer not connected to a domain. Upon execution, domain information will be displayed.

tests.name: Find machines where user has local admin access (PowerView)
tests.description: Find machines where user has local admin access (PowerView). Upon execution, progress and info about each host in the domain being scanned will be displayed.

tests.name: Find local admins on all machines in domain (PowerView)
tests.description: Enumerates members of the local Administrators groups across all machines in the domain. Upon execution, information about each machine will be displayed.

tests.name: Find Local Admins via Group Policy (PowerView)
tests.description: takes a computer and determines who has admin rights over it through GPO enumeration. Upon execution, information about the machine will be displayed.

tests.name: Enumerate Users Not Requiring Pre Auth (ASRepRoast)
tests.description: When successful, accounts that do not require kerberos pre-auth will be returned

tests.name: Adfind - Query Active Directory Groups
tests.description:
Adfind tool can be used for reconnaissance in an Active directory environment. This example has been documented by ransomware actors enumerating Active Directory Groups
reference- http://www.joeware.net/freetools/tools/adfind/, https://www.fireeye.com/blog/threat-research/2019/04/pick-six-intercepting-a-fin6-intrusion.html

tests.name: Enumerate Active Directory Groups with Get-AdGroup
tests.description:
The following Atomic test will utilize Get-AdGroup to enumerate groups within Active Directory.
Upon successful execution a listing of groups will output with their paths in AD.
Reference: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/activedirectory/get-adgroup?view=windowsserver2022-ps

tests.name: Enumerate Active Directory Groups with ADSISearcher
tests.description:
The following Atomic test will utilize ADSISearcher to enumerate groups within Active Directory.
Upon successful execution a listing of groups will output with their paths in AD.
Reference: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/scripting/use-the-powershell-adsisearcher-type-accelerator-to-search-active-directory/

tests.name: Get-ADUser Enumeration using UserAccountControl flags (AS-REP Roasting)
tests.description:
When successful, accounts that do not require kerberos pre-auth will be returned.
Reference: https://m0chan.github.io/2019/07/31/How-To-Attack-Kerberos-101.html

tests.name: Get-DomainGroupMember with PowerView
tests.description: Utilizing PowerView, run Get-DomainGroupMember to identify domain users. Upon execution, progress and info about groups within the domain being scanned will be displayed.

tests.name: Get-DomainGroup with PowerView
tests.description: Utilizing PowerView, run Get-DomainGroup to identify the domain groups. Upon execution, Groups within the domain will be listed.

tests.name: Active Directory Enumeration with LDIFDE
tests.description:
Output information from Active Directory to a specified file. [Ldifde](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-server-2012-R2-and-2012/cc731033(v=ws.11)) is a CLI tool for creating, modifying and deleting directory objects.
The test is derived from the CISA Report on Voly Typhoon. Reference: https://media.defense.gov/2023/May/24/2003229517/-1/-1/0/CSA_Living_off_the_Land.PDF

tests.name: Active Directory Domain Search Using LDAP - Linux (Ubuntu)/macOS
tests.description: Output information from LDAPSearch. LDAP Password is the admin-user password on Active Directory
